payload.title: Check whether Factory actually intercepts delegated Codex tasks
payload.hypothesis: Factory may route tasks through a dispatcher before execution, potentially explaining different native-computer tool exposure between direct local tasks and Rivet-created durable tasks. The reported change between direct coding and a Codex lifter route is a lead, not established causality.
payload.observed: After desktop reinstall and a fresh authorized registration, Rivet-created tasks still expose unified computer-use with native APIs disabled and no standalone node_repl. A direct local task previously had native access. The task-host distinction persists; reinstall has not established a routing fix.
payload.request: Please independently inspect existing authorized Factory deployment switches, integration hooks and dispatcher execution-path evidence read-only. Focus on actual interception/integration and non-secret dispatcher log evidence. Rivet is already reviewing local FactoryDev selectors and CLI behavior, so avoid duplicate blind tests.
evidence_needed: Identify the relevant source/configuration locations and exact current switch values, with source revision or observation time where available.

Trace whether a supported causal path connects task creation, Factory routing, selected execution host and native-tool provisioning. Distinguish configured, actually executed, and merely proposed behavior.
State what evidence supports or falsifies interception of all delegated tasks. Historical OFF/codex_session_dispatch_not_registered is background, not current proof.
Return useful partial findings promptly, or the precise access/evidence blocker and a realistic next handoff estimate.
payload.limits: Read-only investigation through existing authorized access. Do not change Factory settings, services or configuration, launch jobs, or test GUI input. Report sanitized technical findings only: no credentials, private connection values, host identifiers, personal paths or raw private logs.
payload.reply_expectation: A correlated receipt plus substantive findings or a clear blocker; a substantive reply may carry the receipt. No acknowledgment loops.
